components.fact_note: Passage to Fact Check Underlined in Red.
instructions.title: 📋 How to Fact-Check This Citation
instructions.step1: Carefully read the quoted Wikipedia passage and compare it to the source content
instructions.step2: Select a label: Supported, Not Supported, Mixed, Unverifiable, or Source Link Error
instructions.step3: Quote exact verbatim text from the source that supports or contradicts the passage
instructions.step4: Explain how the quote relates to the passage, note any uncertainties
instructions.step5: Skip any statement you're unsure about or don't wish to evaluate

landing.explanation_hint: Provide context for your decision. This is required unless you skip.

email.approval.p1: Congratulations! Your test submission has been reviewed and approved by our research team.
email.approval.p2: You are now qualified to begin contributing to our fact-checking research. You will receive $3 per annotation completed, in accordance with the research participation agreement.
email.approval.p3: Within the next few days, you will receive a formal research participation agreement detailing the annotation guidelines, payment terms, and data usage. Please review and sign it to proceed with annotating.

email.rejection.default_reason: Your test submission was not approved. Please review the instructions and retake the test.
